turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
urope: MESHKI UK
Australia, New Zealand, and other regions: MESHKI AU

Taxes are included in the product price for multiple countries. However, some orders may incur additional customs or duties based on the destination country and order value. These are government charges, so they are the customer’s responsibility and are outside MESHKI’s control. You can check the shipping options and estimated delivery time for your location on any product page by entering your country and postal or ZIP code.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail: For US orders, Standard shipping is currently listed as an estimated 3-7 business days. Delivery estimates can vary by destination, so the most accurate dated estimate will appear on the product page or in your cart after entering your ZIP code. Orders aren’t processed on weekends or public holidays.
